title: Module 14 Vocabulary Check
intro: Answer each item. Feedback comes right away. Items you miss come back for a retry round.

items.q: The regression line is the line that
o: Minimizes the sum of squared prediction errors
Is the same as the median
items.why: This is the least squares criterion.

items.q: In the equation Y-hat = bX + a, b is
o: The slope, the predicted change in Y for each one unit increase in X
items.why: The slope is computed as SP divided by SS of X.

o: The predicted value of Y when X is zero
items.why: It is computed as the mean of Y minus b times the mean of X.

o: The difference between an observed Y and the predicted Y
items.why: Residuals show prediction error for each case.

items.q: The standard error of estimate measures
o: The typical distance between actual Y values and the regression line
The proportion of variability in Y accounted for by the predictor(s)
items.why: In simple regression it equals r squared.

items.q: The regression line always passes through
o: The point (mean of X, mean of Y)
items.why: This follows from how the intercept is computed.

o: Two or more predictors to predict one outcome
items.why: Each coefficient reflects the unique contribution of that predictor with the others held constant.

o: Predictors are highly correlated with each other
items.why: It makes the individual coefficients unstable and hard to interpret.

items.q: Predicting Y for an X value far outside the range of the data is
items.why: The linear pattern may not continue beyond the observed range.
